'''Victra Sinde''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who served the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. Circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Sinde was tasked with an undercover mission on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to obtain evidence that the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] had committed [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, she was unsuccessful at gathering any conclusive proof of his disloyalty.

Several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after commencing her assignment to watch over Organa, Sinde was ordered to undertake business negotiations with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne|Darga]] on the planet [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. While conducting her meeting with Darga, Sinde was recognized by a group of freelance agents whom she had previously crossed paths with on Alderaan. The agents revealed to Organa that Sinde was an Imperial spy, forcing her to abandon her undercover mission.

==Biography==
[[File:Bail_Organa_Coruscant_background.png|thumb|left|200px|Bail Organa, the senator spied on by Sinde]]
Victra Sinde was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] intelligence organization an during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="AWH" /> Around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Echoes of the Jedi]],'' the fourth instalment of the ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]''  campaign, states that the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] traveled to the [[Almas Academy]] two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. This thus indicates that ''Dawn of Defiance'' is set in circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].</ref> Sinde was assigned to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]],<ref name="AWH" /> an influential [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial senator]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="TTG">{{DoD|The Traitor's Gambit}}</ref> who was suspected of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Empire. Under the alias "Alysa," Sinde infiltrated Organa's personal security force and assumed a position within [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|his palace]]<ref name="AWH" /> in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]]<ref name="TTG" /> on Alderaan. In this role she also saw service aboard the [[Resurgence (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Resurgence'']], an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]<ref name="AWH" /> operated by the [[Alderaanian Security]] enforcement agency.<ref name="TTG" />

{{RPG|''[[A Wretched Hive (adventure)|A Wretched Hive]]''}}
After several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] undercover, Sinde encountered a group of freelance agents in the halls of Organa's palace<ref name="AWH" /> who had been summoned by the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] to undertake a [[Mission to Felucia (Imperial Period)|mission]] to rescue the [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] [[Gilder Varth]].<ref name="TTG" /> Sinde was unsuccessful at gathering any conclusive evidence that Organa had betrayed the Empire and [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the freelance agents met with Organa, the Imperial agent was temporarily re-assigned to undertake business talks with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne|Darga]] on the world [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. Darga was covertly trading [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] with the Empire for use on a [[Sarlacc Project|secret project]] to construct a [[Super Star Destroyer prototype|prototype Super Star Destroyer]], and Sinde was ordered to re-negotiate the Empire's arrangement with the Hutt to secure a supply increase.<ref name="AWH" />

[[File:Dargathehutt.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Darga, the Hutt crime lord who Sinde conducted business negotiations with]]
Accompanied by two veteran [[clone stormtrooper]]s, Sinde traveled to [[Darga the Hutt's palace|Darga's palace]], concealed within the ruins of several abandoned [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] estates in the city [[Zarra]] on Cato Neimoidia. Upon arrival, Sinde received an audience with Darga and set out the Empire's proposals, asking for the crimelord to double the amount of tibanna that he transferred to the Empire in return for an 80% rise in payments, claiming this to be a fair offer that would increase the Hutt's profits. The Imperial agent outlined that a further 20% payment increase was available if Darga upped the number of slaves that he procured for the Empire. As a gesture of goodwill, she also offered to provide Darga a personal Imperial security retinue, consisting of [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] of [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] to be based in Zarra and a [[Flight/Legends|flight]] of Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="AWH" />

The freelance agents that Sinde had crossed paths with in Organa's palace had joined Darga's entourage while on an assignment for the [[Alderaanian Resistance]]. The agents observed as Sinde set out the Empire's requests to Darga and the Hutt sought their advice on how to respond to her, agreeing to double the supply of tibanna but declining to provide additional slaves or accept the Imperial escort. The freelance agents recognized Sinde from their [[Time/Legends|time]] on Alderaan and confronted her; she initially denied spying on Organa but after the agents repeated their allegation Sinde mentally made note of their names and faces and determined to make the Empire aware of the agents' activities. The freelance operatives subsequently informed Organa that Sinde was an Imperial spy and this revelation resulted in outcry at his court on Alderaan. Sinde received advance warning that Organa had been advised of her true allegiance to the Empire and she declined to return to her undercover assignment at the senator's palace.<ref name="AWH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Victra Sinde considered her assignment to conduct business with Darga the Hutt on Cato Neimoidia to be well above her. She did not expect to encounter anyone at Darga's palace who would identify her from her undercover assignment on Alderaan.<ref name="AWH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Victra Sinde appeared in [[A Wretched Hive (adventure)|''A Wretched Hive'']], a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure by [[Rodney Thompson]] set within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity that was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[December 20]], [[2007]]. The adventure was the second instalment in the ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' campaign, a supplement to the [[Saga Edition]] of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]].<ref name="AWH" />

In ''A Wretched Hive'', the players roleplay as the Alderaanian Resistance agents that cross paths with Sinde on Cato Neimoidia and it is possible for the players to recognize the Imperial agent from when the player characters traveled to Alderaan during the events of the previous ''Dawn of Defiance'' adventure, ''[[The Traitor's Gambit]]''.  If the players did not previously roleplay ''The Traitor's Gambit'' they can instead recognize her from her time aboard the ''Resurgence''. If the players are persistent with insisting that they recognize her from a previous encounter, Sinde makes sure to remember them and it is suggested that she could then act as an antagonist to the player characters later in the ''Dawn of Defiance'' campaign when the Alderaanian Resistance agents travel to the worlds of [[Nizon]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="AWH" /> during the events of the ''Dawn of Defiance'' modules ''[[The First to Strike]]''<ref name="TFTS">{{DoD|The First to Strike}}</ref> and ''[[The Core of Corruption]]'' respectively.<ref name="TCOC">{{DoD|The Core of Corruption}}</ref> It is also possible for the players to inform Bail Organa that Sinde is an Imperial spy, in which case her cover is blown and she does not return to Alderaan.<ref name="AWH" />
